name: planbraid-bridge-symbols
description: Optional dependency install for the bridge's E7 symbol extraction (symbols.mjs). The bridge itself (planbraid-hook.mjs) has zero required dependencies and works with no npm install at all; run `npm install` in this directory only if you want repository symbol grounding (RECONCILIATION_ARCHITECTURE.md §7). Without it, symbols.mjs degrades to reporting no symbols, silently.
